NDEF · MIFARE Classic · Ultralight · DESFire · ISO 15693 · FeliCa · ISO-DEP

This app is built on the native Android NFC framework (NfcAdapter / android.nfc.tech).

Read capability:
• NDEF text, URI, MIME, Smart Poster records
• MIFARE Classic sector read/write, key authentication, factory reset
• MIFARE Ultralight page read/write
• ISO 15693 block read/write
• ISO 7816 APDU passthrough (61xx continuation handled automatically)
• FeliCa, NFC-A/B/F/V raw protocol frames

Write capability:
• NDEF content write and format
• MIFARE Classic single block write
• Ultralight single page write
• ISO 15693 block write
• Arbitrary raw command passthrough

Note: some cards ship locked or require auth keys; write capability is limited by the card's own permissions.
